name: claude-phoenix-skills-marketplace
description: Deployable Claude Code skills, organized into collections. First collection: cost optimization — cut token spend on every agent run.

plugins.name: ml-engineering
plugins.description: Autonomous ML engineering: the ml-engineer agent turns a prompt or problem statement into a trained, evaluated model, looping until done, blocked, or a user-set iteration cap. Skills: problem-framing, data-prep, model-sweep, train-tune, evaluate-select, experiment-loop.

plugins.name: cost-optimization
plugins.description: Token/cost-optimization skills + orchestrator agent: model routing, context pruning, output compression, prompt-cache optimization.

plugins.name: coding
plugins.description: Agentic coding workflows + orchestrator agent: explore-first, tdd-loop, debug-rca, safe-refactor, ship-it.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Safety and quality guardrails + orchestrator agent: no-destruction, secret-guard, scope-guard, dep-guard, verify-before-done.

plugins.name: documentation
